text:
Supplier Export Classification Request Form
In accordance with Netas’ Export Compliance Policy, we ask our suppliers to provide the export classification data of their products (hardware and software).
Please fill out the Product Classification Table below for all products provided to Netas. You may attach an Excel spreadsheet to this form if there are numerous items.
Product Classification Table
Supplier Part Number	Product Name and Description	Export Classification (e.g. ECCN, EU Dual-Use Code, USML Number)	License Exception / EU GEA (e.g. NLR, ENC(b)(1))	CCATS	Tariff / HTS Code / GTİP (in Turkish)	Country of Origin
U.S. Export Controls Regulations
Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
For dual-use or less sensitive military items – administered by the U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS). http://www.bis.doc.gov/index.php/licensing/commerce-control-list-classification/export-control-classification-number-eccn
International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
For sensitive military items – administered by the U.S. Department of State, Directorate of Defense Trade Controls (DDTC). https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/
EU Export Controls Regulations
European Union Dual-Use Regulation (EC) No 428/2009 (2017 consolidated version) governs the EU's export control regime.
If your items are military, then please refer to the national military list of each member state.
I hereby certify that on behalf of (Company Name) JERA ELEKTRONİK TİC. SAN. LTD. ŞTİ. that the information given above accurately represents the export classification for the parts listed above as of the signature date of this submission.
